> Visual maps — the charts a consultation draws on (CE-6). The standard chain, and the order is the security model: requireTenant -> authenticate -> requireAuth -> authorize -> validate -> handler ── ONE CODE, BOTH DIRECTIONS, LIKE THE TEMPLATES AND UNLIKE THE VOCABULARY ── `clinical.visual_map.manage` gates the reads here as well as the writes. `/clinical-data` makes the opposite call, and the difference is who needs the answer: every screen that renders a diagnosis needs the VOCABULARY, so gating the dictionary behind the permission to edit it would show a receptionist uuids where the words should be.
